issues.quote: revenue rising 2.0% to $383.3 billion from $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: Apple's fiscal 2024 revenue was $391.0 billion, not $383.3 billion; $383.3 billion is the fiscal 2023 figure. As written, the sentence contradicts itself because the same number can't show 2.0% growth.

data.summary: The analysis is accurate except that fiscal 2024 revenue is misstated as $383.3B; Apple reported $391.0B. Gross profit, the margins, operating income, R&D, net income and EPS all match Apple's reported results.
